title: Maps and Timetables
text:
A map shows you the places in a town. It has roads, parks and buildings. You can find the school on the map. Look at the key to understand the symbols.

A timetable shows when buses and trains leave. The bus leaves at eight o'clock. The timetable is on the wall at the bus stop. Read the times carefully before you go.

questions.text: Why is the key useful on a map?
options: It is a kind of bus

questions.text: Where would you probably look to find out when a train leaves?

vocabulary.definition: a drawing that shows places and roads
a list that shows when buses or trains leave
small pictures that have a special meaning
a place where buses wait for passengers

paragraph_translations: Harita, bir kasabadaki yerleri gösterir. Yollar, parklar ve binalar vardır. Okulu haritada bulabilirsin. Sembolleri anlamak için açıklamaya bak.
Tarife, otobüslerin ve trenlerin ne zaman kalkacağını gösterir. Otobüs sekizde kalkar. Tarife otobüs durağındaki duvardadır. Gitmeden önce saatleri dikkatlice oku.
